# nanoraster documentation

nanoraster renders binary glTF (GLB) models to deterministic PNG, WebP, or JPEG
images. Node.js uses native packages on macOS arm64, Linux x64 glibc, and
Windows x64. Browsers use WebAssembly and WebGPU.

The singular renderGlbToImage operation returns name, bytes, and mimeType. The
batch renderGlbToImages operation preserves view IDs and order. Requests select
camera angles, dimensions, format, quality, fit margin, up axis, projection,
background, and optional axes, label, and physical scale overlays.

RenderError exposes stable adapter-unavailable, device-lost, gpu, parse,
encode, and unknown codes. isGpuFault is true for transient GPU failures.

Documentation: https://nanoraster.tau.new/docs
Source: https://github.com/taucad/nanoraster
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/nanoraster
